title: Fasmora 3.690.899 is available
message: A newer version of Fasmora is available with improved browsing, AI, tabs, ads, and update handling.
whatsNew: Added Open in background tab to the long-press link menu
Improved long-press link actions and Fasmora AI link handling
AI conversations now open at the latest message
Improved native ad loading with shared coordination and reduced duplicate requests
Improved update security and trusted APK URL validation
